project.name: BulkBite Operations
project.purpose: Keep kitchen stock truth fast, reviewable, and dependable

company.intent: Make receiving, production use, and physical counts obvious to kitchen workers
evidence: Reviewed receipts, approved recipes, measured usage, physical counts, immutable stock events, and accountant exports

needs: A quick way to receive stock, record what was used or left, and reconcile real stock

constraints: Frappe remains the host, authentication, database, permission, and API boundary
ERPNext is not installed and cannot be a runtime dependency
Worker documents create review drafts only and never post stock automatically
Every component job uses one selected Desyium owner and public System export
Frappe UI owns form and operational controls before shadcn-vue or project providers
No raster image inspection is used for design or validation
